sentences.text: This {stage} {sex} bearded seal was tracked for {days_tracked}, from {first_date} to {last_date}: {species_rank_days}.
Bearded seals live in Arctic and sub-Arctic waters with sea ice and feed mostly on the sea floor.
His positions stay between {southernmost_lat} and {northernmost_lat}, and his farthest point from the start, {max_displacement_km} away, came on {farthest_date}.
His record has one long silence of {longest_gap_days}, shown on the map as a dashed line.
Where he was during that time isn't known.
